scheme_name: Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme
description:
The Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme was launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh on 15th July 2021.

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance and coaching support to candidates aspiring to clear the Union Public Service Commission examinations.

The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance the representation of candidates from economically weaker sections in civil services.

The scheme specifically targets candidates from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and economically backward classes.

The government has set a measurable target to provide coaching to at least 1,000 candidates annually under this scheme.

The coaching will cover the preliminary and main examinations conducted by the UPSC.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is up to INR 1 lakh per candidate.

This amount can be utilized for coaching fees, study materials, and other related expenses.

The scheme also aims to provide mentorship and guidance to candidates throughout their preparation journey.

Eligibility criteria for this scheme include candidates who are residents of Uttar Pradesh.

Candidates must belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, or economically weaker sections.

The age limit for applicants is set at a maximum of 32 years for general category candidates.

For OBC candidates, the age limit is extended to 35 years.

Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes candidates have an age limit of 37 years.

Candidates must have completed their graduation from a recognized university.

The application process requires candidates to fill out an online application form available on the official website of the Uttar Pradesh government.

Candidates must provide necessary documents such as proof of residence, caste certificate, and educational qualifications.

The application form must be submitted within the specified timeline announced by the government.

The government has not specified a fixed deadline for applications but typically opens applications in July each year.

Disbursement of funds is made directly to the coaching institutes selected by the candidates.

The coaching institutes must be recognized and accredited by the government.

The selection of coaching institutes is based on their track record and success rates in preparing candidates for civil services.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official website of the Department of Social Welfare.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for the first year of implementation of this scheme.

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years based on the response and demand for the scheme.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to empower marginalized communities.

The Chief Minister has emphasized the importance of civil services as a means of public service and governance.

The scheme is expected to bridge the gap in access to quality coaching for civil services aspirants.

In the first year, over 500 candidates have already benefited from the scheme.

The success rate of candidates who received coaching under this scheme will be monitored and evaluated.

The government plans to publish annual reports detailing the outcomes and effectiveness of the scheme.

The scheme also includes provisions for workshops and seminars to enhance candidates' skills.

Candidates will receive guidance on interview preparation and personality development.

The government aims to create a supportive ecosystem for civil services aspirants.

This initiative aligns with the national goal of increasing the representation of diverse communities in civil services.

The scheme has received positive feedback from candidates and coaching institutes alike.

The government encourages candidates to utilize the resources provided under this scheme effectively.

Candidates are advised to stay updated on announcements related to the scheme through official channels.

The scheme is a significant step towards ensuring equitable opportunities for all aspirants.

The Chief Minister has reiterated the commitment to support education and employment for underprivileged sections.

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of the state by empowering youth.

The government has also partnered with various educational institutions to enhance the quality of coaching.

Candidates are encouraged to form study groups and utilize peer learning as part of their preparation.

The scheme is a testament to the government's focus on inclusive growth and development.

Candidates are urged to maintain regular communication with their chosen coaching institutes.

The government plans to expand the scheme to include online coaching options in the future.

This will ensure that candidates from remote areas have access to quality coaching.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at youth empowerment.

The government is committed to reviewing and improving the scheme based on feedback from beneficiaries.

The Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme represents a proactive approach to civil service preparation.

This initiative reflects the government's dedication to fostering a more inclusive civil service landscape.

Candidates interested in the scheme should prepare their documents in advance to ensure a smooth application process.

The government has also set up a helpline for candidates to address any queries related to the scheme.

This helpline is available during working hours and can assist candidates with the application process.

The scheme is a critical component of the Uttar Pradesh government's strategy to enhance educational opportunities.

The government aims to create a generation of civil servants who are representative of the state's diverse population.

Overall, the Chief Minister’s UPSC Combined Civil Services Coaching Scheme is a landmark initiative.

It provides essential support to aspiring civil servants from underprivileged backgrounds.

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the civil services landscape in Uttar Pradesh.
